description: This file contains a suite of smoke tests for various SwiftUI views related to application settings in a macOS app. It tests building the views' bodies and exercises private methods for multiple settings screens such as cron, config, debug, general, sessions, instances, permissions, root, about, voice wake, and skills settings.

classes.name: SettingsViewSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test cases verifying the UI views for application settings.

methods.name: `cron settings builds body`
methods.description: Tests the construction of the body for the CronSettings view with a store containing sample cron jobs.

methods.name: `cron settings exercises private views`
methods.description: Exercises private testing methods within the CronSettings view.

methods.name: `config settings builds body`
methods.description: Verifies the ConfigSettings view's body can be built without error.

methods.name: `debug settings builds body`
methods.description: Verifies the DebugSettings view's body can be built without error.

methods.name: `general settings builds body`
methods.description: Checks that the GeneralSettings view constructs its body properly given an AppState in preview mode.

methods.name: `general settings exercises branches`
methods.description: Exercises internal branches of the GeneralSettings view for testing purposes.

methods.name: `sessions settings builds body`
methods.description: Verifies the SessionsSettings view can build its body with sample session rows.

methods.name: `instances settings builds body`
methods.description: Tests constructing the body of the InstancesSettings view with a sample list of instances.

methods.name: `permissions settings builds body`
methods.description: Verifies the PermissionsSettings view's body is constructible with sample permission states.

methods.name: `settings root view builds body`
methods.description: Checks the construction of the SettingsRootView's body in preview mode.

methods.name: `about settings builds body`
methods.description: Verifies the AboutSettings view's body can be created.

methods.name: `voice wake settings builds body`
methods.description: Builds the VoiceWakeSettings view with a sample state and verifies the body.

methods.name: `skills settings builds body`
methods.description: Tests building the SkillsSettings view body.
